about: NEAR AI's published test vectors for its end-to-end encryption, version 2, Ed25519, copied under the MIT licence beside this file from github.com/nearai/inference-sdk at commit 9cc67f723614781f70c8e7475c909780483d35e8. The first is the ed25519 case of rs/tests/fixtures/e2ee-python.json (sealed by NEAR's Python SDK 0.1.0 for the key of the seed). The second is the fixed response vector of js/test/e2ee.spec.ts (seed of 32 bytes 0x0b, plaintext 'fixed v2 vector'); that file gives no public key, so the one here was derived from the seed with OpenSSL 3.6.4, which gives the first vector's published key from its seed alike.
